d:
We've discussed different ways to increase pushup numbers through practice (tl;dr, about 2-3 sets of as many as you can once or twice a week can usually get you pretty far)
However, I've noticed that a lot of BIG leaps in pushup number improvement comes from slight tweaks of form. For SOME people. It really depends on how you're currently doing them. However, most people who casually do pushups probably have a *slight* bottleneck in their technique. They may be relying a bit too much on smaller muscles or slight amounts of unnecessary strain.
